mostWorthwhile.text: Making eyes was the strongest payoff: it gave the swimmers a meaningful ability while explaining its possible uses and diverse histories.

leastWorthwhile.text: The brief progression from soft-bodied animals to swimmers felt predictable and offered little explanation.

surprise.text: The explanation that multicellularity evolved independently in several lineages made the single recipe feel less like a literal evolutionary pathway.

arbitrary.text: Adding membranes to cell colonies produced multicellular life, but the particular role of membranes in that transition was not clear from the result.

continue.text: Yes, cautiously: the emergence of eyes and the hints of multiple evolutionary histories make me curious about what the world develops next, though much of this chapter felt straightforward.
